editorial:
John McClane is older, grumpier, and still impossible to kill. This time he teams up with a young hacker named Matt Farrell to stop a group of cyber terrorists who want to shut down America's entire computer system. The vibe is pure old-school action mixed with modern tech fears, and it works better than you might expect. Bruce Willis brings his usual charm, and the banter between him and Justin Long keeps things light even when the explosions get huge.

The action scenes are the real star here. You get a fighter jet chasing a truck, a car driving into a helicopter, and plenty of shootouts. The pacing rarely slows down, which keeps you glued to the screen. On the downside, the plot can feel a bit silly and the villains are not very memorable. Still, if you want a fun, loud action movie, this delivers. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, McClane and Matt track the villain Thomas Gabriel to a server farm. Gabriel tries to escape by helicopter, but McClane shoots him dead. Matt then uses his hacking skills to redirect a satellite and stop the cyber attack. The movie ends with McClane and Matt driving off together, with McClane finally earning Matt's respect. It is a satisfying, explosive finish that wraps up the story cleanly.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big action movies with a tough hero and lots of explosions.
